Set up & run

Hosts

Which agent hosts Sigma runs on, how each is installed, and what was measured on each. Where something was not measured, the table says so.

On this page
  • Claude Code
  • Codex
  • Cursor
  • Antigravity
What holds on every host

Rules enforced by plain Python in the kit behave the same wherever the kit runs. Rules enforced by a hook exist on Claude Code only; Sigma uses no Cursor or Codex hooks. A rule that is only an instruction to the agent is checked by no code. Holds by construction does not mean measured on that host.

Claude Code

QuestionAnswer
How it is installedPlugin marketplace: claude plugin marketplace add, then claude plugin install sigmaloop@sigmaloop
Init flagNone
MeasuredThe full seven-phase run. The pull request and merge gate, against real merged pull requests with an independent post-PR review. The install, in an isolated profile.
Not measuredCost and time are recorded only where the host reports them. The open items are listed in the platform support document linked below.
HooksThe only host with hooks

Running in Claude Code's web (cloud) sessions works differently from a local session: see Cloud sessions in Claude Code.

Codex

QuestionAnswer
How it is installedPlugin marketplace: codex plugin marketplace add, then codex plugin add sigmaloop@sigmaloop
Init flag--codex
MeasuredThe marketplace install in an isolated Codex home. The first loop command, in a disposable real Codex session. The plugin inventory and phase usage data, against the real Codex CLI and session store.
Not measuredA complete Codex goal through to a merged pull request. The Claude-specific unattended watcher has no Codex budgeted backend; a separate Codex supervisor is opt-in.
HooksNone used

Cursor

QuestionAnswer
How it is installedFrom a clone of the Sigma repository.
Init flag--cursor
MeasuredIn the Cursor app, on a private scratch repository (18 Nov 2026): /sigma-init --cursor with the GitHub-mode flags set the repository up with a Projects board, and /sigma-doctor reported all checks ready. /sigma-goal 1 --land first refused because work.auto_merge was off; with it set to always, it ran a real issue to a merged pull request with passing tests. The pull request was merged by hand: on a free-plan private repository GitHub refuses the branch-protection read with HTTP 403, and Sigma then holds a merge (see the opt-in work.protection_unreadable in the configuration reference).
Not measured/sigma-loop on several goals, the Cursor command-line agent, hooks, and an auto-merge on a repository whose protection can be read.
HooksNone used. Cursor documents a hooks system; Sigma does not use it and no behaviour depends on it.

Antigravity

QuestionAnswer
How it is installedagy plugin install https://github.com/Agrim-Intelligence/sigma, from the public repository. Antigravity converts the Claude Code plugin: 46 skills and 4 hook groups.
Init flag--antigravity (opt-in)
MeasuredIn agy 1.5, on a private scratch repository (18 Nov 2026): the install above, which skips two hooks (the UserPromptSubmit hook and the PreToolUse hook on skills). /sigma-init --antigravity with the GitHub-mode flags ran inside agy and produced a GitHub-mode setup with a Projects board and an AGENTS.md.
Read from the installed output, not exercisedThe four hook groups are PostToolUse, PreToolUse, SessionStart and Stop. The install log gives Antigravity having no such event or tool as the reason for the two skips. The converted skills still contain the Claude-only ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR} placeholder, and each skill carries a note telling the model to use its own folder.
Not measuredA goal run (/sigma-goal), the loop, whether the converted hooks fire (their paths are relative), the headless agy -p command, and an independent reviewer.
HooksConverted by the install, not measured
Technical detail

Every row above comes from platform support. The per-rule table of what enforces what, by host, is enforcement.
